You're about to start something that goes beyond a quick 21-day fix. This challenge is designed to help you build the foundation for real, lasting results. While you'll likely see physical changes over the next three weeks, what we're really focused on is setting you up for long-term success — so you keep making progress well after the challenge ends.

Remember: your results will be directly linked to your commitment and consistency. This is about building a foundation, not chasing quick fixes — give it everything you've got.

21-Day Lean & Strong Challenge · Welcome Guide
1
What You'll Receive
🥗 Nutrition Guidance

Personalized calorie & macro targets, Meal Prep & Food Environment guides, and a Recipe Collection across 7 categories.

🏋️ Training Programs

4 structured programs based on your schedule and environment. All available in the Workouts section of the app from Day 1.

📞 Coaching & Community

Two live group coaching calls per week and a private community forum for daily support and accountability.

🎓 Education

Educational videos every other day across 3 weekly themes — designed to help you understand the why behind what you're doing so results last.

2
Nutrition in Detail
Personalized Targets

You'll receive specific targets for calories, protein, fat, and carbohydrates. For these 21 days, focus on hitting your calorie and protein goals — these are the two variables that matter most for improving body composition.

Meal Prep & Recipe Collection

Guides to plan your meals and set up your food environment for success. Plus 7 recipe categories covering everything from Protein Prepping to Quick & Easy Breakfasts.

3
Training in Detail

Choose the program that fits your schedule and environment. All programs are available in the Workouts section of the app.

3x Full Body — Gym
3x Full Body — Home
4x Upper-Lower — Gym
4x Upper-Lower — Home
Weekly Technique Feedback

Submit up to 3 exercise videos by end of day Thursday in the dedicated forum thread. The coaching team delivers feedback on Friday. Use it — it's one of the highest-value parts of this challenge.

Daily Step Goal

Aim for 8,000–10,000 steps per day outside of your scheduled workouts. It adds up more than you think.

4
Coaching & Community
Weekly Group Coaching Calls

Two live calls every week — Wednesdays at 6:30 PM EST and Saturdays at 10:00 AM EST. Bring your questions, wins, and challenges. If you can't attend live, drop your question in the forum beforehand and we'll address it on the call.

Community Forum

Your private space to ask questions, share meals, post wins, and support others. Daily engagement with the forum is one of the best predictors of success in this challenge — use it.

5
Educational Content

Content drops every other day. Mark each video as complete in the app once you've watched it.

Week 1 — Foundations
  • Why people struggle to achieve lasting fitness success
  • Stop focusing on weight loss — start focusing on body composition
  • The role of exercise, lifestyle & nutrition
Week 2 — Optimization
  • Hierarchy of nutrition: energy balance, food choices & timing
  • Why fad diets fail — enjoy your diet
  • Strength training fundamentals: patterns, volume & intensity
Week 3 — Long-Term Success
  • Mindset and consistency for long-term success
  • Success stories from past clients
  • Apply what you've learned and set new goals

9
Support & Contact
Message the Challenge Team (in the app) For logistics, dates, how the challenge works, and how to use the app. Message the Strong Standard Challenge team directly inside Everfit. This is a team account, so someone is always there to help.
The Community Forum For anything about training, nutrition, or technique, post in the forum. When you ask there, the whole coaching team can answer and everyone learns from it, not just you.
challenge@strongstandard.com Only if you're having a technical problem getting into the app. If you can't log in, email us here and we'll get you sorted.
If something feels too personal to post in the forum, you can send it to the Challenge Team in the app and we'll pass it along privately. The Challenge Team may also reach out to you from time to time with reminders and check-ins.
